dialogue.text: D-Dad?! What's happening?! What did she do to you?!
PJ... that feeling... that familiar darkness... It's her.
Starlight... Get... OUT... She's... in my head...
Well, well. Look what the little star-child dragged in.
And she brought my favorite broken toy along for the ride.
Tell me, little demon... does the sound of his pain remind you of the day you lost your eyes?
Get away from her, you bitch! Dad, snap out of it!
Oh, he'll snap. But not in the way you're hoping. Sing for them, my pet.
